P1.source: Independently reread Table2 and Section5.3/conclusion p.8 and the abstract. All nine AoT-SFT/AoT-O3 pairs and all accuracy margins were transcribed and recalculated with decimal arithmetic.
P1.alternative_and_dependency: One-decimal rounding cannot account for 62.4 versus69.59 or46 versus52.57. All nine displayed direction comparisons remain favorable. An 80% result could concern another denominator, subgroup or individual trajectory; the supplied aggregate table does not identify it. No universal impossibility or experiment fabrication follows.
P1.severity_and_repair: Minor retained: replace the two ranges and15-17pp game accuracy range. The headline needs traceable evidence or a displayed-aggregate maximum69.6% qualification. These corrections do not reverse the central directional comparisons.

C1.source: Reread Eq.(2)-(5) pp.6-7 and B.3.2/B.4 p.16, including the explicit warning against summing positive rewards and the custom RLOO qualifications.
C1.independent_argument: Under uniform trajectory sampling of Ti, the expectation is max(1-.02n,-.5)+.2k/n for a correct trajectory and-1 otherwise. At n=75 the base term saturates. For fixed k it is nonincreasing, but no further base length incentive remains thereafter. Certain correct(n75,k4) gives-.489333;80% correct(n4,k4) gives.696 expected unregularized reward. Thus per-trajectory correctness preference is not a lexicographic policy-accuracy guarantee. A whole-trajectory score-function estimator differentiates the trajectory average times log pi, not an assumed sum of rewards.
C1.alternative_and_dependency: The KL term can change policy preferences, and actual table accuracies increase. The paper acknowledges its value-model interpretation; no reward-hacking bug is inferred. If w=2048 means tokens rather than transitions, (1-beta)/w=.000732421875 differs from alpha.02, but the authors may use a different conversion. Custom trainer, masking, parser and50-step/50-warmup scheduler remain unavailable.
C1.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained: precise normalization and trainer configuration, without alleging historical implementation failure.

C2.source: Reread Table2 and AppendixB.2 test size/generator and B.4 evaluation setup. Independently enumerated all possible paired overlap counts consistent with the displayed success margins.

independent_argument.length_bound: At68% success, Manhattan lower bound15 only implies an all-attempt mean>=10.2 if each step is a legal single-tile move. Mean14.2 is therefore possible. A successful-only legal-move mean14.2 would be incompatible, but that denominator is not established.

C2.alternative_and_dependency: These are feasible significance ranges, not tests on absent original pairs.100-case percentages need not describe multiple seeds. Transition descriptions have varying token count; no latency/energy measurements follow from step means. Failures, truncation and textual versus legal-move counting can explain the puzzle average.
C2.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained: disclose paired outcomes, length denominator and token/runtime measurements. No statistically insignificant or impossible-trajectory verdict is justified from margins alone.
